screens: resolution bound (smallest separable effect at ~80% power)
sign consistency across chronological thirds of the hypothesis's own span
effect net of a 0.02% round trip must still clear the bound
method.macro_lookahead_guard: macro read at day t; gold's forward window opens at the close of day t+1

limitations: Daily close-to-close only; nothing here bears on intraday entry timing.
The broad trade-weighted dollar index is not the ICE DXY. It is used only after a replication check on the overlapping window, and that check is reported whether or not it passes.
The 10-year real yield is a direct TIPS measurement from 2003, but gold's daily series starts 2008, so the extension is 2008-2026 rather than the full TIPS history.
A pre-registered hypothesis that fails on a larger sample is a stronger null than the same hypothesis failing on a smaller one. It is still a null.

coverage.gold_start_is_binding: FRED's LBMA gold series were withdrawn over licensing, so the gold side could not be extended past 2008-01-04

design.why_no_family_correction_on_primary: It was written down by the previous study before this sample existed, so it is not a selection from this study's output and correcting it against this study's secondaries would penalise it for company it did not choose.

primary.claim: The bottom quintile of 20-session change in the 10-year real yield (DFII10) precedes a stronger 20-session return for gold.
primary.origin: pre-registered by RS-XAUUSD-20260824-004 h17, which measured +0.4808% against a 0.5277% bound on 3196 sessions
primary.null: the real yield carries no information about gold's next month
primary.reason: effect +0.3803 is inside the +0.5648 these samples can separate

secondary.claim: The real yield LEVEL, not its change: bottom quintile precedes a stronger month.
secondary.origin: level versus change was never separated in the predecessor
secondary.null: the level of the real yield carries no information
secondary.reason: effect -0.3807 is inside the +0.4191 these samples can separate

secondary.claim: A negative real yield is a regime, not a quantile: gold does better whenever DFII10 is below zero.
secondary.origin: the most commonly stated version of the gold-and-real-rates claim
secondary.null: the sign of the real yield carries no information
secondary.reason: effect clears the resolution bound but bootstrap p=0.059

secondary.claim: The nominal 10-year yield falling hardest over 20 sessions precedes a stronger month.
secondary.origin: the nominal channel, separated from the real one
secondary.null: the nominal yield carries no information beyond the real yield
secondary.reason: effect clears the resolution bound but bootstrap p=0.212

secondary.claim: Rising breakeven inflation precedes a stronger month for gold.
secondary.origin: the inflation-hedge claim, on nine more years than the predecessor had
secondary.reason: effect -0.1438 is inside the +0.5830 these samples can separate

secondary.claim: A bottom-quintile 20-session move in the broad dollar index precedes a stronger month.
secondary.origin: RS-XAUUSD-20260824-004 h18 on ICE DXY, 1174 sessions, 71.49% win rate
secondary.null: the dollar carries no information about gold beyond the accounting link
secondary.reason: effect +0.0651 is inside the +0.5147 these samples can separate

secondary.claim: Falling real yields AND a falling dollar together.
secondary.origin: the two macro channels required to agree
secondary.null: the conjunction carries no more information than its parts
secondary.reason: effect +0.2483 is inside the +0.9002 these samples can separate

secondary.claim: A top-quintile VIX reading precedes a stronger week for gold, on 2008 onward.
secondary.origin: the safe-haven claim, now including the 2008 crisis the predecessor excluded
secondary.null: equity volatility carries no information about gold
secondary.reason: effect +0.1290 is inside the +0.3453 these samples can separate

family_permutation_secondary_only.reading: the chance that a family of this size produces a result this strong when every member is noise

dollar_replication.question: Does the broad trade-weighted dollar index reproduce the ICE DXY result on the window where both exist? Only then may it extend the sample.
dollar_replication.reading: Same sign and win rates within 10 points is the bar. The two indices weight different currencies, so exact agreement is not expected and would be suspicious if it appeared.
